what_does_it_do: Establishes a new IS-05 transport for NMOS Senders and Receivers implementing USB over IP and allows Controllers to establish compatible connections.
Establishes a standardized mechanism for NMOS Senders and Receivers to declare support for USB over IP transport streams using IPMX/USB (VSF TR-10-14).
why_does_it_matter: An NMOS Controller can verify that any Receiver is compliant with a Sender producing USB over IP transport streams, as only IPMX/USB-compliant Receivers can process such content.
A standardized framework enables Controllers to systematically verify and/or enforce compliance.
how_does_it_work: Documents how IPMX/USB capabilities are announced by both Senders and Receivers.
Outlines the requirements for Senders, Receivers, and Controllers regarding the IPMX/USB feature.
